title: Intern
jobDescription: Job Title: Customer Support Intern Designation: Customer Support Intern Department: Customer Experience BU: Service Excellence Location: Lucknow Internship Duration: 3 Months Stipend: ₹5,000 per month About Adda247 Started in 2016, Adda247 is India's largest Ed Tech platform, catering to more than 40 million users annually. The Adda247 App is ranked the #1 Android App in terms of usage among all Education Apps in India, as per the latest Similarweb rankings. Adda247 houses multiple platforms, including the Adda247 mobile app, Adda247 You Tube channels, Bankersadda, SSCAdda, Teachers Adda, and Career Power. With more than 1 million daily video views, 0.5 million daily active users on the app, and 2.5 million daily active users on the web, Adda247 is one of India's largest and fastest-growing education technology platforms. Visit our website: www.adda247.com Follow us on Linked In: www.linkedin.com/company/adda247/ Why Join Us? Here is your chance to join a young, energetic, and dynamic team with a vision to transform the education space in India. This internship will provide you with hands-on experience in customer support, communication, problem-solving, and customer relationship management in a fast-paced Ed Tech environment. Requirements Any Graduate pursuing / Post Graduate pursuing. Freshers and candidates with 0-1 year of experience are welcome. Fluent English communication skills are mandatory. Good verbal and written communication skills. Strong interpersonal and customer-handling skills. Positive attitude and willingness to learn. Key Learning Gain hands-on experience in handling customer queries through calls, emails, and chat. Develop strong communication and interpersonal skills while interacting with customers. Learn how to understand customer concerns and provide appropriate solutions. Gain practical knowledge of customer support processes and service guidelines. Learn to use CRM systems to record and manage customer interactions. Develop problem-solving and conflict-resolution skills. Understand the importance of customer satisfaction and delivering a positive customer experience. Learn to work with internal teams to resolve customer issues effectively. Gain exposure to performance metrics and target-driven work environments. Develop teamwork, time management, and professional workplace skills. Improve product knowledge and learn how to effectively communicate product information to customers.

title: Exam Counsellor
jobDescription:
Job Title: Exam Counsellor (Inside Sales) Company: Adda247 Vertical :K12 Industry: Ed Tech Work Mode: Work From Office Location: Sector 39, Unitech Cyber Park, Gurugram (Work From Office) About the Role Adda247 is hiring Exam Counsellors . We are looking for enthusiastic and result-oriented candidates who have excellent communication skills and are passionate about helping students choose the right courses while achieving sales targets. Key Responsibilities Counsel prospective students regarding UG exam preparation courses. Understand students' requirements and recommend suitable courses. Handle inbound and outbound calls to generate enrollments. Convert leads into admissions through effective counselling. Build and maintain strong relationships with students. Achieve monthly sales and admission targets. Maintain accurate records of student interactions in the CRM. Eligibility Criteria Graduate in any discipline. Freshers and experienced candidates are both welcome to apply. Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills. Basic understanding of sales/customer handling. Willingness to work in a target-driven environment. Salary CTC: ₹2.0 LPA
- ₹3.5 LPA In-hand Salary: Based on interview performance and last drawn salary (for experienced candidates). Why Join Adda247? Opportunity to work with one of India's leading Ed Tech companies. Career growth in counselling and sales. Performance-driven incentives. Learning-oriented and collaborative work environment.

title: Exam Counsellor
jobDescription: About Adda247 Started in the year 2016 and funded by marquee investors like Google, Westbridge & Infoedge, Adda247 is a B2C product-based company on a mission to solve India's education problems at thegrassroot level. The multilingual Ed Tech platform provides 360-degree learning solutions cateringtoall major educational needs of Tier II, tier III including online courses for competitive exams like Banking, SSC, Teaching exams, Defence exams, GATE, JEE, NEET, UPSC and state exams. Companyhas also recently entered the K12 segment targeting state board students in Tier II, Tier III andsmall towns. With more than 15 million monthly active users and 2 million paid users, Adda247 is alreadyone of the largest and most loved Ed Tech players in India. Join us on Facebook www.facebook.com/adda247live/ Follow us on Linked In www.linkedin.com/company/adda247/ Why join us? Here is your chance of joining a young, energetic team with the vision to transform the education space in India. Some things that stand us apart include Role with a purpose in a fast-growing organization Collaborative culture Flexible working policy Subsidized Lunch Party culture Regular off sites Fun at work with gymnasium, table tennis, pool etc. We are a Great Place to Work certified organization.. What you will do? Take prospects from the initial contact phase to the qualified phase over the phone. Present product solutions virtually. Generate revenue by counseling prospects and converting them to sales. Meet and exceed pipeline contribution goals. Respond quickly to assigned leads Willingness to be measured by weekly and monthly metrics. Use and become an expert on the Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system. There is a headset calling which happens with clear metrics. It is only an in office job (No work from home) What you will need? Any Graduate / Post Graduate / MBA (marketing). Experience in Inside Sales / Outbound Sales / Tele Sales / Educational Sales will be added advantage. Good written and spoken English. Good negotiation and pitching skills are required. Passion to work in a fast-paced start-up. Multi-disciplinary and continuous learning mind-set. Customer focus with a good convincing ability and confident personality
